g.text: 04 AI discovery and its LST touchpoints

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #00355F
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; text-anchor: start; fill: #00355F

g.text: AI candidates need physical construction and experimental feedback. Orders depend on funded projects.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; text-anchor: start; fill: #00355F

g.text: Stages 2–3 have more direct exposure. Clinical and manufacturing demand face attrition and time lags.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; text-anchor: start; fill: #00355F

g.text: Source: supplied framework and product-use research. Arrows describe a mechanism, not realized orders.
